import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define GSL constants
GSL_SUCCESS = 0

# Define the gsl_sum_levin_utrunc_workspace structure
class GslSumLevinUtruncWorkspace(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("sum_plain", ctypes.c_double),
        ("terms_used", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("q_num", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
        ("q_den", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double))
    ]

def gsl_sum_levin_utrunc_accel(array):
    array_size = len(array)
    if array_size == 0:
        return 0.0, 0.0

    array_type = ctypes.c_double * array_size
    c_array = array_type(*array)

    # Allocate workspace using GSL function
    gsl.gsl_sum_levin_utrunc_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(GslSumLevinUtruncWorkspace)
    gsl.gsl_sum_levin_utrunc_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GslSumLevinUtruncWorkspace)]

    workspace_ptr = gsl.gsl_sum_levin_utrunc_alloc(ctypes.c_size_t(array_size))
    if not workspace_ptr:
        raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate GSL workspace.")

    try:
        # Prepare output variables
        sum_accel = ctypes.c_double()
        abserr_trunc = ctypes.c_double()

        # Call the GSL function
        gsl.gsl_sum_levin_utrunc_accel.argtypes = [
            ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double),
            ctypes.c_size_t,
            ctypes.POINTER(GslSumLevinUtruncWorkspace),
            ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double),
            ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)
        ]
        result = gsl.gsl_sum_levin_utrunc_accel(
            c_array,
            ctypes.c_size_t(array_size),
            workspace_ptr,
            ctypes.byref(sum_accel),
            ctypes.byref(abserr_trunc)
        )

        if result != GSL_SUCCESS:
            raise RuntimeError("GSL function failed with error code: {}".format(result))

        return sum_accel.value, abserr_trunc.value

    finally:
        # Free the allocated workspace
        gsl.gsl_sum_levin_utrunc_free(workspace_ptr)

def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: Simple array
    array = [1.0, 0.5, 0.25, 0.125]
    sum_accel, abserr_trunc = gsl_sum_levin_utrunc_accel(array)
    expected_sum = 2.0  # Corrected expected value for accelerated sum
    assert np.isclose(sum_accel, expected_sum, atol=1e-6), f"Test case 1 failed: {sum_accel} != {expected_sum}"

    # Test case 2: Single element array
    array = [42.0]
    sum_accel, abserr_trunc = gsl_sum_levin_utrunc_accel(array)
    assert sum_accel == 42.0, f"Test case 2 failed: {sum_accel} != 42.0"

    # Test case 3: Empty array
    array = []
    sum_accel, abserr_trunc = gsl_sum_levin_utrunc_accel(array)
    assert sum_accel == 0.0, f"Test case 3 failed: {sum_accel} != 0.0"
    assert abserr_trunc == 0.0, f"Test case 3 failed: {abserr_trunc} != 0.0"

    print("All test cases passed!")
